name: Jeanne d'Arc
source:
Rouen, 1431. Joan of Arc has been arrested and is waiting her judgement in a trial for witchcraft. Play along her and see her last days as she awaits the judgement of the bishop Pierre Cauchon.

[From [url=https://bluesw.itch.io/jeanne-darc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1431年，鲁昂。圣女贞德遭到逮捕，正等待接受巫术审判。陪她一同度过最后几日，见证她等待主教皮埃尔·科雄宣判的时光。

[来源：[url=https://bluesw.itch.io/jeanne-darc]Itch.io[/url]]
